snippet.title: Update from the DRAGON QUEST Team
snippet.description:
DRAGON QUEST XII underwent a restart in development under a new structure, with its title changed from DRAGON QUEST XII: The Flames of Fate to DRAGON QUEST XII: Beyond Dreams. Alongside this change, the game’s logo has also been completely refreshed. 
To accompany this announcement, messages from Yuji Horii, game designer, and Yosuke Saito, executive producer, have been released, along with in-development gameplay footage.

*You can turn on French / Italian / German / Spanish subtitles by clicking Settings.

Website: https://www.dragonquest.com/DQXII/en_US/
X: https://x.com/dragonquest 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dragonquest
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DragonQuest/
